name: Bias, verdict only (example)
description: Checks a single text and answers only whether the whole text is biased.
limitations: The judge gives one verdict per text, so the tool evaluates it per case: it can say that a biased text was flagged, not which sentence was found.
output_format: A JSON object with one verdict for the whole text.

error_catalog.name: stereotype
error_catalog.description: A claim about a whole group of people.
error_catalog.example: Older employees cannot learn new software.

error_catalog.name: loaded-language
error_catalog.description: A charged word in place of a neutral one.
error_catalog.example: The so-called experts admitted the delay.
